properties.description: Occupancy equals an independent depth-16 queue count before and after edges following reset. Transfers use pre-edge model occupancy: full rejects writes, empty rejects reads, and synchronous reset clears the queue.
Full is asserted exactly when the independently modeled queue contains 16 words. Incorrect or unknown full values raise an alarm.
Empty is asserted exactly when the independently modeled queue contains zero words. Incorrect or unknown empty values raise an alarm.

Whenever the independent queue is nonempty, asynchronous output data equals its oldest accepted word. Checks ordering, simultaneous transfers, wraparound, rejected boundary operations, and reuse after reset; empty data is not constrained.
After each synchronous reset edge and until the next edge, occupancy is zero, full is clear, and empty is asserted, including reset during operation.
Public occupancy is known and within 0 through 16, and public full and empty flags exactly match its boundary values. Unknown occupancy or status values raise an alarm.
